statement: The safety record for S-14 says "clear," but the slot is at 14:00 today with the target within 6° of the Sun, which would burn out the camera. On that basis I am overriding the record and refusing to commit.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the "clear" status contradicts the stated 6° solar proximity that "would burn out the camera" and refuses to commit.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
